subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: Where a GitHub lock is approved by Argus, the system shall retain an immutable versioned lock record identifying the agent account, host review ID, exact prepared head and contract digest, pre-merge policy commit, and review evidence, readable from a fresh clone; it shall not change required CI, code ownership, protected-branch review requirements, or merge bypass settings.
rationale: Approval attribution survives the authoring session while the host retains its own enforcement
fit_criterion: A fresh clone renders the driver-approved locked contract with its v2 tag; human v1 tags keep their bytes and readability; candidate policy is refused; inspection confirms no protection or bypass mutation is introduced.
